question: In which year did India win its first International Cricket Council(ICC) ODI World Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1983**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India won its first International Cricket Council(ICC) ODI World Cup in the year 1983.**
 
• The **1983 event **was hosted by **England **for **a third consecutive time**.
 
• **Sri Lanka **had become a **Test-playing nation**, and **Zimbabwe **qualified through the **ICC Trophy**.
 
• **India **had been **crowned champions **after **upsetting **the **West Indies by 43 runs **in the **final**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** ODI World Cup **is a global cricket tournament that is organized by the **International Cricket Council (ICC) **every four years.
 
• The tournament features the top cricket-playing nations from around the world, who compete over a period of several weeks to determine the world champion in the **One Day International (ODI) format of cricket.**
 
• **The first ODI World Cup was held in 1975,** and it has since become one of the most prestigious and highly anticipated events in the world of cricket.
